as_told.title: Gene Huff's view of Lazar approaching Dennis at the casino

plain: In 1989, in a Las Vegas casino, Bob Lazar is said to have had a strange last meeting with a man named Dennis Mariani, who would not look at him and then vanished. Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien spacecraft at a secret site in Nevada, and he tells it himself. He says he kept saying "Dennis, Dennis, I'm here, you know, what do you want?" but Mariani "never even looked up at me". Lazar walked over to his friend Gene Huff, and when they both turned around, "he was gone." A researcher named Luigi Vendittelli tells the same scene as Huff told it to him. In that version Mariani is a blonde, "military-looking guy" and Lazar talks to him while "the guy's not even looking at him." The scene is told as one of the odd moments around the time Lazar says he worked on the craft.
